description: Scroll at the current filtered DOM node point, or actual CSS visual viewport center when node_id is omitted, using native synthesizeScrollGesture at speed 8000 with preventFling. Optional target_id addresses only that already-owned page without selecting, creating or focusing it. Requires the declared native browser transport.

node_id.description: Current filtered-DOM node_id from browser.dom_snapshot. This is not an accessibility @m ref.

target_id.description: Exact already-owned page returned by browser.tabs or browser.tab_new. This does not select, show, create, or focus that page.
